question: Success green is close to the accent green. Which fix?

options.name: Option A: yellower success green
options.description: Keep the deep-green accent. Move success toward olive so positive amounts read differently from actions (hue gap about 15° becomes about 40°).

options.name: Option B: muted ink-blue accent, green only for success
options.description: Accent becomes a desaturated ink-blue (not navy: lightness 0.40 light / 0.75 dark, low chroma). Green is reserved for success and gains (hue gap about 100°).
